Name: (Content Patcher) Variety Crops
Author: Cringlers
Description:
[size=3]How to unlock recipes:[/size][spoiler]
[list]
[*]Baked sweet potato: Bought from Gus at the Saloon
[*]Candied sweet potato: Get 3 hearts with Evelyn
[*]Sweet potato fries: Reach farming level 2
[/list][/spoiler]
[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install SMAPI[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install content patcher[/url]
[*]Download the zip folder and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size][list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer
[/list]
[size=5]Changelog[/size]
Version 1.0.0: Initial Release
[list]
[*]Adds sweet potato crop, seeds, and three food items
[/list]
Version 1.0.1: Bug Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed unlock conditions for recipes not working
[*]Changed description for sweet potato seeds to be more consistent with other seed items
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Variety Crops
Manifest.Description: A simple mod that adds a sweet potato crop, as well as a few related items
Manifest.Author: Cringlers
